name: Reiek Tlang Mountain Peak & Heritage Village
opening_hours: Daylight hiking hours (29 km drive from Aizawl)
best_time: October to April (Anthourium Festival in autumn)
rules: 30-minute forested trail ascends to cliff precipice at 4,800 ft offering views of Bangladesh plains
Visit the authentic replica of a traditional Mizo chieftain village at base
visual_features: breathtaking mountain promontory terminating in an abrupt vertical rocky cliff edge looking out over rolling mist-filled green valleys
description: Reiek is a mountain and tourist spot 29 km from Aizawl, Mizoram, India. It rests at an elevation of 1,465 metres overlooking Aizawl and offers a view of the surrounding valleys and hills. On a clear day, the plains of Bangladesh can be seen from the top of the hill. Reiek Hill is surrounded by thick lush green temperate trees and bushes.
